name: European Alternatives

sources.title: Homepage — 'Sign up for an account to suggest changes or new products'
About — listing conditions (EU/EEA/EFTA/DCFTA/UK-based company), suggestion-tool workflow
Register — account creation endpoint for the suggestion tool (returned no readable content)

requirements: Company must be based in an EU, EEA, EFTA, or DCFTA member country or in the UK — this includes any parent/holding company
Hosting providers may not simply resell/sub-host on infrastructure of a non-EU/EFTA company (e.g. configuring servers on AWS does not qualify)
Open-source projects that can be self-hosted are also listed; the geography criteria do not apply to them but the product must be reasonably easy to self-host
Suggestions are only accepted through the site's suggestion tool after registering an account — the site explicitly says product/category suggestions sent via chat or email will not be processed
preparation: Evidence the company (and any parent company) is based in EU/EEA/EFTA/DCFTA/UK
Which existing category the product fits — new categories cannot currently be suggested
Product name, URL, and description for the suggestion tool
workflow: Sign in and use the suggestion tool to submit the product as a new entry for an existing category (or a change to an existing product)
Do NOT submit via the chat bubble or email — those channels are explicitly not processed
Wait for editorial review; the site researches each product before adding it
watchFor: Strict geography rule — a US-headquartered product (or one with a US parent) does not qualify
The optional 'EU hosted' label has its own stricter criteria (core services hosted in the EU by EU-based companies; US-owned CDNs/DDoS providers on the critical path break eligibility)
This is a suggestion queue, not instant listing — editorial research gates publication
A tool to suggest new categories is 'being worked on' — only existing categories can receive product suggestions
Affiliate links exist on the site but the about page says they get no preferential treatment
countsAsLive: The product appears as a public entry on european-alternatives.eu under its category, linking to the product website
unknowns: The exact fields in the suggestion tool (it is behind account registration)
